remarks: SELLER FINANCING AVAILABLE! Escape to the peaceful countryside with this incredible recreational retreat in Angelica, NY! Situated on 5.37 scenic acres, this versatile property offers privacy, outdoor adventure, and future building potential. Whether you're searching for a turnkey hunting camp, a relaxing weekend getaway, or the ideal location to build your dream home, this property is ready to enjoy from day one. With utilities available at the road, the parcel also offers residential building potential. At the heart of the property sits a beautifully finished Amish-built cabin with electric service, a generator hookup, and a wood-burning stove for year-round enjoyment. An Amish-built outhouse provides added convenience. The expansive front lawn offers plenty of room for campfires, entertaining, and relaxing outdoors. Beyond the open lawn, the property transitions into mature hardwoods with a picturesque creek winding through the woods, creating exceptional wildlife habitat and endless opportunities for hunting, hiking, and exploring. Located just minutes from the historic Village of Angelica, you'll enjoy easy access to local shops, restaurants, and nearby outdoor destinations including Rushford Lake, Letchworth State Park, and Allen Lake State Forest. Buy it just in time for hunting season! Can also be packaged with Lots 14 & 16, creating over 18 acres of recreational and residential opportunities. Whether you're looking for a hunting camp, weekend escape, or future homesite, this property is ready for your next adventure. Taxes to be Determined
